releaseNotes:
﻿## Guest Inbox
- Save contact and booking identity follow the opened message’s sender in multi-person threads (recommender vs guest)
- Show To, Cc, and Bcc on messages; Reply and Reply all like a normal mail client
- Stop Cc’d / earlier thread contacts from being treated as the booker and blocking a new booking

## Calendar & meals
- Hold bookings use a light orange fill with an orange border
- Monthly conference row sits above guest rooms
- Conference meal counts follow guest flight/time rules (including breakfast after late arrival)

## Value of Service
- Modular statement sections with editable labels
- Family names on covers; clearer Additional day guests (unnamed meal extras)
